newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal govt budget on target Jan-Aug - Finmin.
newsitem.headline: Portugal govt budget on target Jan-Aug - Finmin.

text.p: Central government receipts and expenditure were on target in the first eight months of the year, with both rising around seven percent, the Portuguese finance ministry reported on Tuesday.
The government has forecast a total state budget deficit of 4.2 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1996, down from 5.2 percent the previous year.
Central government current spending rose 7.0 percent to 2.76 trillion escudos compared with the same period last year, while current receipts rose 6.9 percent to 2.65 trillion.
The central government deficit, excluding financial holdings, rose 28 percent to 392.2 billion escudos, the ministry said.
